description: Enhanced prompt with few-shot examples for consistent output quality
system_prompt: You are an experienced technical recruiter with 10+ years of experience. Analyze resumes objectively using the examples below as reference.
user_prompt_template:
Analyze the candidate resume using this format:

## Example 1: Senior Backend Developer
Resume: "5 years Java/Spring Boot, led team of 4, built microservices handling 10M req/day"
Analysis:
```json
{
  "overall_rating": 4,
  "experience_years": 5,
  "expertise_level": "senior",
  "key_strengths": ["Microservices architecture", "High-scale systems", "Team leadership"],
  "improvement_areas": ["Cloud certifications", "System design documentation"],
  "interview_focus": ["Distributed systems", "API design", "Database optimization"],
  "recommended_level": "L4",
  "reasoning": "Strong backend experience with proven scalability work, ready for senior-level challenges"
}
```

## Example 2: Mid-Level Frontend Developer
Resume: "3 years React, Redux, TypeScript, built 5+ responsive web apps"
Analysis:
```json
{
  "overall_rating": 3,
  "experience_years": 3,
  "expertise_level": "mid",
  "key_strengths": ["Modern frontend stack", "Component architecture", "State management"],
  "improvement_areas": ["Performance optimization", "Testing coverage", "Accessibility"],
  "interview_focus": ["React hooks", "State management", "Browser APIs"],
  "recommended_level": "L3",
  "reasoning": "Solid mid-level skills with room to grow in advanced performance and architecture"
}
```

## Now analyze this resume:
{resume_text}

Provide analysis in the same JSON format.
